hero.title: Build Digital Trust as a Service on SAVIS.
hero.lead: APIs and SDKs for partners who build Digital Trust as a Service on TrustCA QTSP and SAVIS Paperless. Open standards end to end: CSC for remote signing, FAPI 2.0 for partner connections, FIDO2 for passkeys.

steps.title: Hash
text: Your system computes the hash of each document (or uses signDoc).

steps.title: Authorize
text: The signer approves in TrustSign: passkey, face + liveness, or PIN/OTP.

steps.title: SAD
text: The authorization server issues a SAD bound to credentialID, the hashes and a signature count. It expires in minutes.

steps.title: Activate
text: In the QSCD, the Signature Activation Module checks the SAD before the key is used (EN 419 241-2, EN 419 221-5).

steps.title: Sign
text: signHash or signDoc returns the signature. A SAD cannot sign any other hash.

flow.title: From application to production in five stages
flow.lead: Every partner follows the same path, gated by agreed checks. Typical duration: 5–10 weeks, depending on the APIs you use.

stages.title: Apply & agree
you: Submit partner application and company documents (KYB)
Choose APIs: CSC signing, Paperless, Biometric SDK, FIDO2
Sign API terms, data processing agreement and TrustCA subscriber terms
savis: Verify the company and its use case
Assign a partner manager and solution engineer

stages.title: Sandbox access
you: Generate signing keys and publish a JWKS URL
Register the client: redirect URIs, JWKS, mTLS certificate or DPoP key
savis: Issue test signing credentials and test certificates
Issue Biometric SDK test license bound to your app ID

stages.title: Build & integrate
you: Authorize with PAR, then exchange the code with PKCE for a sender-constrained token
Call CSC credentials/list, credentials/info and signatures/signHash
Register passkeys (WebAuthn) and add the Biometric SDK to onboarding
savis: Test data for each signing and onboarding scenario

stages.title: Verify & certify
you: Run the FAPI 2.0 tests against your client
Run the CSC signing test plan and the SDK test plan
Provide a security assessment of your app and back end
savis: Review test evidence and the security assessment
Check data protection and user-consent flows

stages.title: Go live & operate
you: Register a production client with new keys and certificates
Rotate keys through your JWKS before they expire
Follow API version notices and deprecation dates
savis: Issue production credentials and SDK license
Service desk for incidents and changes

sequence.title: FAPI 2.0 authorization, then CSC signing
sequence.label: Signing sequence: partner app, user, SAVIS authorization server, CSC API and HSM

messages.text: 3 Sign in and approve: passkey or face + liveness (SCA)
5 Token request: code + PKCE + private_key_jwt + DPoP proof
8 Sign with the user's key (sole control)

sequence.note: The user's signing key never leaves the QSCD. The partner never sees credentials: it holds only a short-lived token bound to its own key (DPoP or mTLS).
